articles.title: The Growing Intersection of Pharmacy Benefits and Stop-Loss Insurance for Employers
articles.summary: Rising specialty drug costs are increasingly driving high-dollar claims, transforming pharmacy benefit management into a critical factor for stop-loss insurance decisions among self-funded employers. This shift matters because uncontrolled pharmaceutical expenses can severely impact stop-loss attachment points and overall risk exposure for organizations sponsoring health plans. Consequently, benefits leaders must closely align their PBM strategies with stop-loss coverage to mitigate catastrophic financial loss and better manage healthcare budgets.
